# Original complex-deck failure sources

The directory name is historical. All 61 original frames and 121 overlay states
now pass independent live LuaLaTeX structural and paint checks on the final
renderer. Original sources remain here unchanged to preserve failure provenance.

The full-frame regression copies and pinned references are in
`../fuzz-original-seed-20261106/` and `../fuzz-original-seed-20261107/`.
See `design/beamer-failure-status.md` for the final reports, fixes, validation,
and remaining coverage/oracle limitations, and `design/beamer-failure-ledger.json`
for every original failure and its current verification.
